# C33 workflow and compatibility scenarios

Repository-authored synthetic Apache-2.0 scenario metadata. Reuses C21 passport v1, C09 ZIP/manifest v1 and C30 signed manifest/files without copying their bytes. The browser test validates their recorded hashes and C30 validates its own complete provenance inventory.

N-1 means these existing supported formats, as selected by the owner. C30 snapshots are produced and reopened/restored by the current unchanged C05 adapter; this is format compatibility, not old-binary/new-binary installed upgrade evidence (C35).

At 360px and 1440px the real C30 CLI harness runs evaluation, independent trust/integrity negatives, ZIP export, operation replay/conflict and new-store restore. Native file chooser activation, clear and cancel use keyboard input. The native file read is held/resumed deterministically only for cancellation testing. Engine HTTP 503 is injected for UI projection; the Go C15 test checks actual missing-provider typed failures separately. No scanner/provider execution is implied by this local core workflow.

The viewer always labels claims unverified. Explicit stale evidence is unknown. Immutable operations cannot be overwritten; no automatic expiry, release ordering or latest-release authority is asserted. Source-like text remains inert.
